notes: All three reviewers reproduced sim + agent runs byte-exactly; failures were all wording/claim discipline, each round finding new overreach. Lessons: (1) before review, check every comparative claim against ALL rows of our own tables, including the baseline that looks best; (2) don't let a title or takeaway generalize a first-step/nominal rate; (3) attribute advice that paraphrases the paper; (4) disclose implementation choices (ddof, floor) in Setup, not later; (5) with a realistic agent the effect was small (<1 pt inflation) - a weaker story than the pure-noise sweep, which made claims harder to keep honest.
